fields.name: TimeLeft
fields.evidence: Replicated without members: serializer bg3.exe+0x8EF9F0 / bg3.exe+0x8EF980 only writes the entity and the dirty mask, no member. macOS default constructor stores w1 = 0x3F800000 (1.0f) at +0. Toolkit esv::thrown::AttachmentSystem::ProcessAnimationRequestComponents subtracts GameTime+8 (frame delta) from the float at +0 each frame and removes the component once it is <= 0: a countdown in seconds.
